quotationNarrative: A premium and slow-paced journey designed for luxury family travelers, showcasing the cultural depth of Hanoi, the cinematic landscapes of Ha Long Bay, the heritage of Hoi An, the beach relaxation in Da Nang, and the dynamic vibe of Ho Chi Minh City.

programOverview.heading: PROGRAM OVERVIEW
paragraphs: This 14-day grand luxury journey is tailored perfectly to capture the essence of Vietnam from North to South.

The itinerary is designed to provide a perfect balance of guided exploration and leisure time, staying in the country's most iconic luxury properties such as The Reverie Saigon and Hyatt Regency Danang.

itinerary.summary: Arrival in Hanoi, transfer to hotel and overnight in Hanoi.
Full day exploring Hanoi highlights. Overnight in Hanoi.
Visit Ninh Binh highlights. Overnight in Ninh Binh.
Transfer to Ha Long Bay. Enjoy cruise and overnight in Ha Long.
Transfer back to Hanoi. In the evening, take the overnight train to Sapa.
Arrive in Sapa. Enjoy a cycling tour around the villages. Overnight in Sapa.
Full day trekking in Sapa through scenic rice terraces. Overnight in Sapa.
Airport transfer, fly to Da Nang. Transfer to Hoi An and overnight.
Experience the basket boat ride and visit My Son Sanctuary. Overnight in Hoi An.
Journey over the spectacular Hai Van pass. Overnight in Hoi An.
Fly to Ho Chi Minh City. Enjoy an exciting Vespa tour. Overnight in HCM.
Visit the Cu Chi tunnels and the War Remnants Museum. Overnight in HCM.
Free day to explore Ho Chi Minh City at your own pace. Overnight in HCM.
Transfer to the airport for your departure flight from Ho Chi Minh City.
